vision.heading: Why we exist
vision.statement: Software built here should stand next to software built anywhere.
body: Calden Digital is a software studio. We started it because too many businesses had been let down — by templates that could not grow, by agencies that sold to them and handed the work to someone junior, and by developers who stopped replying halfway through.

We build the way a serious product should be built: understand the business first, design the experience and the architecture together, then write code that is still serviceable years after launch. Not a launch date. A foundation.

howWeWork.heading: How we work
howWeWork.lead: Design, architecture and testing are part of the build, not extras quoted separately at the end.

items.title: Plan before build
items.body: Every project starts with understanding your business and agreeing a scope in writing. You know what you are getting before anything is made.

items.title: UI/UX designed properly
items.body: Interface and experience design done in-house — clear flows, considered detail, and screens your customers can use without being taught.

items.title: Architecture first
items.body: We design the system before we write it: data models, integrations and structure agreed up front. Good architecture is why a product can grow instead of being rebuilt.

items.title: Tested before it ships
items.body: QA is a step in the work, not something left to you after launch. Things are checked on real devices and real connections before they go live.

items.title: Honest about scope
items.body: If something is not worth building, or is not something we can do well, we will say so. A clear no is worth more than a vague yes.

items.title: Built to last
items.body: Custom code, kept simple, and structured so it can change as your business changes.

team.heading: An experienced team behind every project
team.body: Design, engineering and QA are handled by people who do that discipline for a living. Your project gets the specialists it needs, when it needs them — and the people who scope it stay with it through delivery.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: Calden Digital is a software studio based in Matara, Sri Lanka. You can reach us at hello@calden.lk.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: Only what you send through the contact form: name, email address, project type, timeline, budget range and your message. Nothing else is collected, and there is no account system.

sections.heading: Why we collect it
sections.body: To reply to your enquiry and, if we work together, to discuss the project. The lawful basis is your consent, given by submitting the form.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: Enquiry emails are retained for as long as needed to respond and for our own records, and deleted on request.

sections.heading: Who else sees it
sections.body: The form is delivered by Resend, our email provider, and the site is hosted by Vercel. Neither uses the content of your message for anything else. No data is sold or shared with advertisers.

sections.heading: Analytics
sections.body: We use Plausible Analytics, which is cookie-free and does not track individuals or build profiles. It records aggregate page views, referrers and country. No personal data is collected and nothing is shared across sites.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: We set no cookies for tracking. The only browser storage the site uses is a single localStorage entry remembering your light or dark theme choice.

sections.heading: WhatsApp
sections.body: If you contact us on WhatsApp, that conversation is governed by WhatsApp’s own privacy policy, not this one.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may ask what we hold about you, ask for it to be corrected, or ask us to delete it. Email hello@calden.lk.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: The date this policy was last updated appears at the top of this page.

items.question: How much does a project cost?
items.answer: It depends on what needs building, and we won’t pretend otherwise. A marketing site is a different job from a booking system. We scope the work first, put a fixed figure in writing, and you decide before anything starts. The contact form has budget brackets — pick the one that fits and we’ll tell you honestly what’s achievable in it.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: A content site is usually two to four weeks. A web application depends entirely on scope — we’ve delivered a full tour operator site in two weeks and rebuilt a streaming platform over about a month. You get a timeline in writing with the scope, and we tell you early if something threatens it.

items.question: Do you work with clients outside Sri Lanka?
items.answer: Yes. We’re based in Matara and take on projects island-wide and internationally. Most communication is over email and WhatsApp, with calls when they’re useful. Time zones have not been a problem so far.

items.question: Can you take over a project someone else started?
items.answer: Yes, and we’ve done it more than once. We audit what exists, tell you honestly what it needs, and finish it. Two of the projects in our work started that way — one was days from its deadline with unresolved defects when we came in.

items.question: Who actually does the work?
items.answer: The people who scope your project are the people who write the code and the people you talk to afterwards. No account managers, no handover to someone junior.

items.question: What happens after launch?
items.answer: We stay on if you want us to — hosting, updates, changes and improvements. Launch is not the end of the work. If you’d rather take it in-house, we hand over cleanly with everything documented.

items.question: Will I be able to update the site myself?
items.answer: Yes, for content. We build sites so your team can change text and images without calling us. Structural changes — new page types, new features — are where we come back in.

items.question: Do you design as well as build?
items.answer: Yes. We design the structure and the interface before writing any code, so you can see it and change it while changing it is still cheap. If you already have a designer or a brand, we work to that instead.
